description: Aam Digital base Renovate preset: weekly grouped updates, major updates as drafts, one PR for CI action updates. Extend with "local>Aam-Digital/.github//renovate/default".

packageRules.description: Keeps the name (and branch) the repos already use for the weekly group created by group:allNonMajor.
Major updates need a deliberate review, so they open as drafts. No labels here on purpose: a label set in a package rule would override a repo's own top-level labels.

CI actions and reusable workflows only affect the pipelines, so every update, majors included, lands as one ready PR. Must come after the major rule. Runtime versions passed to setup-* actions, containers and runners are not included.

The org's own reusable workflows are referenced by their major tag (e.g. @v1), which is moved on every release, so they are never pinned to a digest. Grouped separately because a new major usually needs changes in the caller.
